message: You know that one friend who always panics at the mention of a blackout? 😅 Well, I like to think of myself as the calm counterbalance! I recently came across a handy resource that breaks down how to prepare for power outages. It’s all about having a plan in place and knowing what to do when the lights go out. Trust me, a little preparation goes a long way in keeping things relaxed at home. Do you have any favorite tricks for handling a blackout? I'd love to hear them!
